name: DNS Zone Manager
postCreateCommand: npm install && npx playwright install --with-deps && uv sync --extra cli --extra api --extra dev && uv run pre-commit install && uv run pre-commit install-hooks
postStartCommand:
if [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ]; then DOCKER_GID=$(stat -c '%g' /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || stat -f '%g' /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$DOCKER_GID" ]; then getent group docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo groupadd -g $DOCKER_GID docker 2>/dev/null || sudo groupadd docker 2>/dev/null || true; getent group docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo usermod -aG docker vscode 2>/dev/null || true; fi; sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true; fi && uv sync --extra cli --extra api --extra dev --quiet && echo '
✅ Devcontainer ready!

🚀 Start services:
   Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P → Tasks: Run Build Task
   Or: Terminal → Run Build Task

🔗 URLs (after starting):
   Frontend: http://localhost:5173
   Backend:  http://localhost:8000
   Swagger:  http://localhost:8000/docs
   API Key:  demo-api-key-12345

🧪 Testing:
   ./tests.sh              # Unit tests only
   ./tests.sh --all        # All tests (unit + integration + E2E)
   npm run test:e2e:ui     # Playwright UI → http://localhost:9323
   npm run test:e2e:report # Test report  → http://localhost:9324

🔧 DNS Tools (dig):
   dig @bind -p 15353 example.com           # Query A record
   dig @bind -p 15353 example.com ANY        # Query all records
   dig @bind -p 15353 example.com SOA +short # SOA serial

📦 Zone Transfers (AXFR/IXFR):
   dig @bind -p 15353 example.com AXFR -k /etc/dns-api-key.conf
   dig @bind -p 15353 example.com IXFR=12345 -k /etc/dns-api-key.conf

✏️  Dynamic Updates (nsupdate):
   nsupdate -k /etc/dns-api-key.conf <<EOF
   server bind 15353
   zone example.com
   update add test.example.com 300 A 192.0.2.100
   send
   EOF

🔧 RNDC Server Control:
   rndc status
   rndc zonestatus example.com
'
